# Test that cgo -gen-binding generates Go binding files from //cgo: pragmas
# and C headers, and that the result builds without a C compiler.

env GOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT,runtimecgopurego,cgobindings
[!GOEXPERIMENT:cgobindings] skip
[!GOOS:darwin] [!GOOS:linux] skip
[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip
[!exec:cc] skip

# Generate the binding file. Only the pragmas decide what is bound;
# C.Unused, referenced in the input, is not.
cd gen
go tool cgo -gen-binding x.go
stdout '^// Code generated by cmd/cgo -gen-binding; DO NOT EDIT\.$'
stdout '^package main$'
stdout '^// #cgo LDFLAGS: \./libx\.so$'
stdout '^// #cgo noescape Add$'
stdout '^// #cgo nocallback Add$'
stdout '^// #include "c\.h"$'
stdout '^import "C"$'
stdout '^import "structs"$'
stdout '^//cgo:type Small C\.SmallStruct$'
stdout '^//cgo:func Add C\.Add "libx\.so"$'
stdout '^//cgo:type _LargeStruct C\.LargeStruct$'
stdout '^//cgo:type _DoubleFloat C\.DoubleFloat$'
stdout '^type Small struct \{$'
stdout '\t_ structs\.HostLayout'
stdout '^type MyInt = int32$'
stdout '^type FloatUnion \[2\]float32$'
stdout '^type _DoubleFloat struct \{$'
! stdout '_ \['
stdout '^const Limit = 0x64$'
stdout '^const Green = 0x5$'
stdout '^var globalCount int32$'
stdout '^var globalSmall Small$'
stdout '^func Add\(p0 int32, p1 int32\) int32$'
stdout '^func ProcessStruct\(p0 Small, p1 _LargeStruct\) int32$'
stdout '^func Scale\(p0 _DoubleFloat\) float64$'
stdout '^func SumFloatUnion\(p0 FloatUnion\) float32$'
! stdout 'Unused'
! stdout 'func main'
# A declaration in the input is kept as written.
stdout '^// AddFloat is kept as written\.\nfunc AddFloat\(a, b float32\) float32$'
cp stdout ../p/binding.go

# Running -gen-binding on its output reproduces it.
cp stdout regen.go
go tool cgo -gen-binding regen.go
cmp stdout ../p/binding.go

# -gen-binding accepts all the Go files of a package. It keeps the
# declarations in the files that import "C", with their doc comments. z.go,
# which does not import "C", stays in the package next to the output, so its
# declarations (here, the //cgo:dynload type) are left alone, and the names
# -gen-binding invents avoid them. Anonymous C structs and unions are written
# inline or by their typedef name, never by cgo's invented names.
go tool cgo -gen-binding x.go y.go z.go
stdout '^// #include "c\.h"$'
stdout '^// #include "y\.h"$'
! stdout 'runtime/cgo'
stdout '^//cgo:func Add C\.Add "libx\.so"$'
stdout '^//cgo:dynload Calc$'
stdout '^//cgo:func Calc\.Mul Mul$'
stdout '^//cgo:var Calc\.Count GlobalCount$'
stdout '^//cgo:type _Handle C\.Handle$'
stdout '^//cgo:type _U C\.U$'
stdout '^//cgo:type _LargeStruct_ C\.LargeStruct$'
! stdout 'struct___|union___|class___'
! stdout 'type Calc|name string'
stdout '^// Bump is kept as written\.\nfunc \(\*Calc\) Bump\(\)$'
stdout '^func \(\*Calc\) Mul\(p0 int32, p1 int32\) int32$'
stdout '^func \(\*Calc\) Count\(\) \*int32$'
stdout '^type _Handle \*struct \{$'
stdout '^type _U \[4\]byte$'
stdout '^func AnonParam\(p0 \*struct \{$'
stdout '^\tinner struct \{$'
stdout '^// AddFloat is kept as written\.\nfunc AddFloat\(a, b float32\) float32$'
! stdout 'helper'
cp stdout ../p/binding.go
cp stdout regen.go
go tool cgo -gen-binding regen.go z.go
cmp stdout ../p/binding.go

# A generated //cgo:dynload type.
go tool cgo -gen-binding gendyn.go
stdout '^type Gen struct \{\n\tcgo\.Library\n\}$'
stdout '^func \(\*Gen\) Mul\(p0 int32, p1 int32\) int32$'
stdout '^import "runtime/cgo"$'

# -trimpath and no -srcdir work too.
go tool cgo -gen-binding -trimpath=$WORK=>/trimmed/path x.go
stdout '^func Add\(p0 int32, p1 int32\) int32$'

# Pragmas must name C declarations of the right kind.
! go tool cgo -gen-binding bad.go
stderr 'bad\.go:5:1: could not determine what C\.NoSuchFunc refers to'
! go tool cgo -gen-binding kind.go
stderr 'kind\.go:5:1: //cgo:type T: C\.Add is a func, not a type'

# Method pragmas must name //cgo:dynload types, and declarations in the
# input must be bodiless and declared once.
! go tool cgo -gen-binding dynload.go
stderr 'dynload\.go:6:1: //cgo:func Nope\.Add: Nope is not declared with //cgo:dynload'
stderr 'dynload\.go:10:1: -gen-binding: Calc\.Add must be declared on its own'
stderr 'dynload\.go:12:1: -gen-binding: //cgo:func method Unused must have a pointer receiver \(\*Calc\)'
! go tool cgo -gen-binding x.go zdup.go
stderr 'zdup\.go:6:1: -gen-binding: AddFloat is declared more than once'
! go tool cgo -gen-binding x.go otherpkg.go
stderr 'otherpkg\.go:1:9: -gen-binding: package q; expected package main'

# The generated file builds and runs without a C compiler.
cd ../p
cp ../gen/z.go z.go
cc -fPIC -shared -o libx.so ../gen/c.c ../gen/y.c
env CGO_ENABLED=bindings
env CC=/bin/false
[GOOS:linux] env LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.
go run .
stdout '^add=3 addf=3.5 count=7 small=2 process=46 scale=7.5 union=4.0 limit=100 green=5$'
stdout '^anon: handle=9 param=9 union=1 s=9$'
stdout '^dynload: mul=42 count=7$'

-- gen/c.h --
typedef struct {
	int a;
	short b;
	char c;
} SmallStruct;

typedef struct {
	double d;
	float f;
} DoubleFloat;

typedef struct {
	int a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h;
} LargeStruct;

typedef union {
	float f[2];
	struct { float x, y; } s;
} FloatUnion;

typedef int MyInt;
enum color { RED, GREEN = 5 };
#define LIMIT 100

extern int GlobalCount;
extern SmallStruct GlobalSmall;

extern int Add(int a, int b);
extern float AddFloat(float a, float b);
extern int ProcessStruct(SmallStruct s, LargeStruct l);
extern double Scale(DoubleFloat x);
extern float SumFloatUnion(FloatUnion u);
extern void Unused(void);

-- gen/c.c --
#include "c.h"

int GlobalCount = 7;
SmallStruct GlobalSmall = {1, 2, 3};

int Add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
float AddFloat(float a, float b) { return a + b; }
int ProcessStruct(SmallStruct s, LargeStruct l) { return s.a + s.b + s.c + l.a + l.h; }
double Scale(DoubleFloat x) { return x.d * x.f; }
float SumFloatUnion(FloatUnion u) { return u.f[0] + u.f[1]; }
void Unused(void) {}

-- gen/y.h --
typedef struct { int x; } *Handle;
typedef union { int a; float b; } U;
struct S {
	union { int a; float b; } u;
	struct { short p, q; } inner;
};

extern int HandleX(Handle h);
extern int AnonParam(struct { int x; } *p);
extern int UnionA(U *u);
extern int SumS(struct S *s);
extern int Mul(int a, int b);
extern void Bump(void);
extern int GlobalCount;

-- gen/y.c --
// Not including y.h: the untagged struct types here are compatible with the
// ones there only across translation units.
typedef struct { int x; } *Handle;
typedef struct { int x; } P;
typedef union { int a; float b; } U;
struct S {
	union { int a; float b; } u;
	struct { short p, q; } inner;
};
extern int GlobalCount;

int HandleX(Handle h) { return h->x; }
int AnonParam(P *p) { return p->x; }
int UnionA(U *u) { return u->a; }
int SumS(struct S *s) { return s->u.a + s->inner.p + s->inner.q; }
int Mul(int a, int b) { return a * b; }
void Bump(void) { GlobalCount++; }

-- gen/y.go --
package main

// #include "y.h"
import "C"

//cgo:type S C.struct_S
//cgo:func HandleX HandleX "libx.so"
//cgo:func AnonParam AnonParam "libx.so"
//cgo:func UnionA UnionA "libx.so"
//cgo:func SumS SumS "libx.so"
//cgo:dynload Calc
//cgo:func Calc.Mul Mul
//cgo:var Calc.Count GlobalCount

// Bump is kept as written.
//cgo:func Calc.Bump Bump
func (*Calc) Bump()

-- gen/z.go --
package main

import "runtime/cgo"

// This file does not import "C".

type Calc struct {
	cgo.Library
	name string
}

type _LargeStruct int

func helper() {}

-- gen/zdup.go --
package main

// #include "c.h"
import "C"

func AddFloat(a, b float32) float32


-- gen/otherpkg.go --
package q

-- gen/gendyn.go --
package main

// #include "y.h"
import "C"

//cgo:dynload Gen
//cgo:func Gen.Mul Mul

-- gen/x.go --
package main

// #cgo LDFLAGS: ./libx.so
// #cgo noescape Add
// #cgo nocallback Add
// #include "c.h"
import "C"

//cgo:type Small C.SmallStruct
//cgo:type MyInt C.MyInt
//cgo:type FloatUnion C.FloatUnion
//cgo:const Limit C.LIMIT
//cgo:const Green GREEN
//cgo:var globalCount C.GlobalCount "libx.so"
//cgo:var globalSmall GlobalSmall "libx.so"
//cgo:func Add C.Add "libx.so"
//cgo:func AddFloat AddFloat "libx.so"
//cgo:func ProcessStruct C.ProcessStruct "libx.so"
//cgo:func Scale Scale "libx.so"
//cgo:func SumFloatUnion SumFloatUnion "libx.so"

// AddFloat is kept as written.
func AddFloat(a, b float32) float32

func main() { C.Unused() }

-- gen/bad.go --
package main

// #include "c.h"
import "C"
//cgo:func F C.NoSuchFunc libc

-- gen/kind.go --
package main

// #include "c.h"
import "C"
//cgo:type T C.Add

-- gen/dynload.go --
package main

// #include "c.h"
import "C"
//cgo:dynload Calc
//cgo:func Nope.Add Add
//cgo:func Calc.Add Add
//cgo:func Calc.Unused Unused

func (*Calc) Add(a, b int32) int32 { return a + b }

func (Calc) Unused()

-- p/go.mod --
module p

go 1.28

-- p/main.go --
package main

import "C"
import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime/cgo"
	"structs"
)

type handle = struct {
	_ structs.HostLayout
	x int32
}

func main() {
	l := C.LargeStruct{a: 10, h: 30}
	fmt.Printf("add=%d addf=%.1f count=%d small=%d process=%d scale=%.1f union=%.1f limit=%d green=%d\n",
		C.Add(1, 2), AddFloat(1.5, 2), C.GlobalCount, globalSmall.b,
		C.ProcessStruct(Small{a: 1, b: 2, c: 3}, l), Scale(_DoubleFloat{d: 2.5, f: 3}),
		SumFloatUnion(FloatUnion{1.5, 2.5}), Limit, Green)

	var h _Handle = &handle{x: 9}
	u := _U{1}
	s := S{u: [4]byte{4}}
	s.inner.p, s.inner.q = 2, 3
	fmt.Printf("anon: handle=%d param=%d union=%d s=%d\n", HandleX(h), AnonParam(&handle{x: 9}), UnionA(&u), SumS(&s))

	calc, err := cgo.Open[Calc]("./libx.so")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	calc.name = "x"
	fmt.Printf("dynload: mul=%d count=%d\n", calc.Mul(6, 7), *calc.Count())
}
